name: Starship V3 Command Section
description: Flight 12 V3 nose, payload section, avionics and forward flaps. Geometry and mass allocation are restricted public-data engineering estimates. nose_radius_m and axial_drag_coefficient are calibrated engineering estimates: the 3.0 m stagnation radius matches the same 9 m ogive modelled by starship_command, and 0.45 is a slender-body axial Cd on the frontal area for a fineness ratio near 14 (Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag, ch. 3); the transonic rise is applied separately by AerodynamicsModel.GetMachDragMultiplier.
